card.name: Partway through capitalized words before E
card.fires_on: The hyphen-F or similar split inside ALL-CAPS label words, most strongly in BREAST-FEEDING in the pregnancy warning. It fires where the next piece of the word starts with E.

modes.label: Breast-feeding warning
modes.description: The "-F" piece in the capitalized phrase IF PREGNANT OR BREAST-FEEDING.
modes.example: WARNINGS: IF PREGNANT OR BREAST<<-F>>EEDING, ask a health care

modes.label: Other capitalized words split before E
modes.description: Split points inside other all-caps or acronym words where the next piece begins with E.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output a piece starting with the letter E to finish the word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of capitalized label words, mainly BREAST-FEEDING, when an E-piece comes next.
